t: Asking for someone to be healed
a: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
p: Allāhumma Rabba-n-nās, adhhibi-l-ba's, ishfi anta-sh-Shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uk, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.
m: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm. Cure, for You are the Curer. There is no cure but Yours, a cure that leaves no illness behind.
